node.title: Re: using a variable with require
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
See the core module [doc://Module::Load] (there are others, like [mod://Module::Runtime], but this one is core), plus the \&{'subname'} symbolic reference syntax which is allowed even under [doc://strict]. However, if $name is user input, this is still a security risk!

use warnings; use strict; use Module::Load qw/load/; my $name = 'SomeModule'; load $name; (\&{$name.'::somesub'})->();
